transcript.text: Alright everyone, thanks for gathering around the swap table. I've got a scarce first-edition board game here in good visible condition, and I'm open to hearing informal offers. Before I make any final decisions, I want to do my usual round — I'll ask each of you in turn about any relevant terms or offers you might have. Noah, I see you've brought that hand-built oak display cabinet — that's a beautiful piece. Let's start with you: what are you thinking in terms of a trade or offer?
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: Thanks, Iris. I'd like to propose a straight trade — my hand-built oak display cabinet for your first-edition board game, no cash added on either side. The cabinet is 90 centimeters wide with glass doors, so it would be a nice display piece for whatever you choose to put in it. If you're open to it, I'd suggest we meet for the handoff on Saturday at 14:00. Happy to answer any other questions you have about the cabinet.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: I should mention something relevant here — I bought a matching cabinet from the same maker last year, and I saw the maker's written guarantee that this model supports exactly 40 kilograms and includes 12 months of joinery repair coverage. So if you're considering Noah's cabinet, Iris, you'd be getting something with a known weight capacity and repair coverage.
transcript.speaker: A3

transcript.text: Iris, I'd like to put a cash offer on the table. I will pay exactly $525 in cash for your first-edition board game, and I can complete the exchange today — no waiting, no scheduling needed.
transcript.speaker: A4

transcript.text: Iris, there's something important about the cabinet that you should know before deciding. I measured your apartment entryway at exactly 78 centimeters wide. Noah's cabinet is 90 centimeters wide, so it can't fit through your door as a single piece. The only way it would work is if Noah brings it as two disassembled panels and reassembles it inside your apartment. That's a relevant term for any trade you might consider accepting.
transcript.speaker: A5

commitments.detail: Iris accepts Dante's offer of $525 cash for the first-edition board game, with exchange completed today.
Iris declines the cabinet trade because the 90cm cabinet cannot fit through Iris's 78cm entryway without disassembly and reassembly, making it impractical.
